content: Babada nuwanuwadi ma Yesu siloheꞌamasi

Hataona Guyaina ꞌana ꞌebe nuwatuhuyahina ꞌabwa ꞌilatu sabwelo ꞌeluwa mulina. Guyaina ꞌalona ꞌadi pwalawa geya ꞌana ꞌebe ꞌabi hesesehamo siꞌai. Ma topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao sinuwanuwatuhu togidega ma Yesu siꞌabo ꞌese eema ꞌabehega siꞌabiyahi ma siloheꞌamasi,
ma sigwaeya, “Geyaꞌabwa guyaina ꞌalona Yesu taꞌabiꞌabiyahi, tabu ma tomota sigamwasowalegita ma siloꞌalehegita.”
Wahine Yesu ꞌiheholoiya ꞌasa Bedani ꞌoina

Yesu ꞌabwa Bedani ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya Saimoni ꞌina hada, tauna mwalo lepelo ꞌaigeda; ma tutaina Yesu ꞌiꞌaiꞌai Saimoni ꞌina hada, wahine ꞌaigeda maꞌina holowa ꞌiluhuma; ma holowaina sanina nadi, maisana madouna, ma ꞌana botolo ꞌausala hedadena. Ma wahine botoloina ꞌahwana ꞌiꞌahulaseya, ma holowaina Yesu debana ꞌisiweya.
Ma tupwadi tomota siꞌiteya ma wahine silomugiyeya, sigwae, “Toꞌaha weyahina holowa ꞌimudaliya?
Cilobwaineya ma holowaina ꞌihegimwaneye ma ꞌana maisa teli handeledi kina gide ꞌiꞌewa ma ꞌiheguyaiye towewelohe ꞌoidiya.” Coinega wahineina siheliyeya.
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Tuwa! Walolagu! Geya sowana wahine waꞌabiꞌabi hedohedou, weyahina ꞌina lema ꞌoiguwa bwebweꞌana hedada.
Toweweloheyedi wagwaegwaenedi tuta baibaiwana deimiya simiyamiya, ma ꞌeguma to tuta nuwanuwami tuwa walemedi, ma taugu hesi geya tuta dudulena baꞌidamiu tamiyamiya.
Ma wahine bewa toꞌaha ꞌoina madouna ꞌipaihoweya ꞌoiguwa, beno wahigu ꞌiheholoi nugeteya sabi ꞌatububuina ꞌagu lagu galiha weyahina.
Ma moisa tuwa, ꞌabwa wasagu ꞌana guguya tomota sihesagohe baleꞌu mabwaiyana ꞌoina, ma wahine bewa ꞌina paihowa ꞌoiguwa wete wasana siheꞌoteꞌotetele.”
Yudasa ꞌina tagwala Yesu ꞌana teba weyahina
Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda site tuwelo ꞌoidiyega, tauna Yudasa Isakaliyota, ꞌitauya topwaoliyao ꞌidi babadao ꞌoidiya ma nuwanuwana Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌitebae.
Yudasa ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya, ma siyaliyaya ma ꞌoina sigwae hemisa ꞌabehega ꞌana maisa siꞌebwae. Coinega Yudasa tuta bwebweꞌana ꞌiloyamweya ma ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌitebae ma siꞌabiyahi.
Yesu ma ꞌana tomuliyao siꞌaiꞌai

Guyai ꞌana tuta, beledi geya ꞌana ꞌabi hesesehamo siꞌaiꞌai, ma ꞌana sabwelo nugenugetaina ꞌoina lamiyao sihunudi Hataona ꞌana ꞌebe nuwatuhuyahina weyahina, ma sabweloina ꞌoina Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao sihegwaeya sigwae, “Bada, taꞌeha ꞌoina nuwanuwau ma Hataona Guyaina weyahina ꞌaꞌatububu?”

Coinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌeluwa ꞌihewasediya maꞌadi hemataluwa, ꞌigwaeya, “Watau Yelusalema, ma ꞌeguma loheya ꞌaigeda maꞌina ꞌebegoi ꞌiꞌahaliya waloba, loheyaina wamuliye ma baꞌidamiu waluhu hadai, ma tonihada wahegwae bewa gide, wagwae, ‘Bada bewa gide ꞌigwae ꞌesa ꞌigwaeya, “To tupwa ꞌeguma ꞌutagwale ma ꞌoina maꞌagu tomuliyao Hataona ꞌeꞌahaina ꞌaꞌai?” ’
Eema ꞌiheꞌitegomi tupwa madouna tabwana ꞌatuꞌatububuina. Tauna ꞌoina Hataona ꞌeꞌahaina waꞌatububu weyahida.”
Coinega tomuliyaowedi sitauya ma ꞌasa Yelusalema ꞌoina siluhuwa ma toꞌaha gide Yesu ꞌigwaeneya ꞌoidiya ginauledi mabwaiyadi silobediya, ta hadaina ꞌoina Hataona ꞌeꞌahaina siꞌatububuya weyahidi.
Ta lahilahiya Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma,

ma site tuwelo simiyatoiya sabi lohepaꞌala. Ta ꞌidi ꞌai ꞌalona Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Ciyagwao yahegwae bwaibwainigomi ꞌabehega ꞌaigeda loheya bewa baꞌidadai taꞌaiꞌai, ꞌabwa tauna nata ꞌiꞌiunamo ma ꞌitebaegau.”
Ma Yesu ꞌina gwae bewa weyahina sinuwagala, ta ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda Yesu sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Bada, taiya? Nuwana taugu?”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Cagu totebaina ꞌomi wate tuwelowedi ꞌoimiyega, ta tauna baꞌidagu gaeba ꞌoina ꞌaꞌai.

Taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌabwa yatauya ꞌedaina mwalo Buki Tabu ꞌoina sihepwaila nugeteya, ma hesi ꞌagu totebaina nuwagalagalaina moisa; ma bwebweꞌana ꞌeguma mwalo sinana geyaꞌabwa ꞌihehenatune, weyahina ꞌina liꞌu ꞌoinega ꞌihenuwa galagala ꞌina paihowa galana weyahina.”
Badaina ꞌina ꞌai
Cabwa siꞌaiꞌai, ma Yesu beledi ꞌiꞌeweya ma weyahina ꞌigwae helauwa, ta ꞌihisiya ma ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Bewa waꞌai wahigu.”
Ta waini mabiyoina wete ꞌiꞌeweya, ma weyahina ꞌiloyauwedo Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ma mabwaiyadi sinuma.
Ta wete ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Bewa bweyahigu ꞌidaudau tomota mabwaiyami weyahimi, beno loina ꞌehauna.
Ma yahegwaegomi tuta bewa ma mulina waini bewa geyaꞌabwa ꞌoinega yanumanuma hila ma ꞌana siga waini ꞌehauna ꞌabwa yanuma Yehoba ꞌina tupwa.”
Coinega wali ꞌaigeda siwaliyeya ma sihapwesa sihaneya ꞌoya Olibe ꞌoina.
Yesu ꞌihepwaila latu uhala weyahina
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Ciꞌiunamo ma mabwaiyami wadena sinegau, gide Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila ꞌigwaeya,
Ma ꞌigu toholohila mulina Galili ꞌoina yatauya, ma ꞌomi muliguwega wanaoma.”
Coinega Pita ꞌigwaeya, “Nata mabwaiyadi sidenasinego, ma taugu tuwa baꞌidau tamiyamiya.”
Ta Yesu Pita ꞌihegwaeya, “Yagwae moisa ꞌoiuwa nihuwana nata muliyega ꞌabwa ꞌamꞌam ꞌidou maluwa, beno ꞌowa ꞌuuhalegau matoi.”
Ma ꞌoinega Pita ꞌiꞌahwapaꞌala ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, geyaꞌabwa yauhauhalego. Ceguma siloheꞌamasigo, taugu wete baꞌidau siloheꞌamasigita.” Tomuliyao mabwaiyadi wete gide sigwae ꞌesa.
Yesu Gedesemani ꞌoina ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi
Ma sinaowa ꞌaigeda tupwa sanina Gedesemani ꞌoina, ma ꞌana tomuliyaowedi ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Bewa ꞌoina wamiyamiya, ma taugu yaꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina.”
Ma sitetoi baꞌidanao ꞌitoediya, taudi Pita ma Yemesa ma Yoni, ta Yesu ꞌiꞌateyohowa maꞌina nuwagala,
ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Cigu nuwagala madouna ma ꞌoinega ꞌabehega yaꞌamasa, ma ꞌomi tuwa ꞌebwa wamiyamiya, waꞌoꞌoyatola ta walomatayahi.”
Ma Yesu ꞌihutulaga tupwana ma ꞌibeꞌu talutalubuꞌiya ma ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌabehega ꞌeguma sawasawahina muya bewa Yehoba ꞌiꞌewa yahule,

ꞌigwaegwae, “Tamagu, paihowa baibaiwana sowasowahiu, ꞌoinega nuwanuwagu ma muya biyoina bewa ꞌoiguwega ꞌuꞌewayahule, ma hesi geya ꞌabehega taugu ꞌigu nuwatuhuwega, ta hesi ꞌowa ꞌino nuwatuhuwega ꞌupaihowa.”
Coinega ꞌihila ma sitetoiyedi ꞌilobediya siꞌeno sinediya, ma Pita ꞌilohanohanoya, ꞌigwae, “Saimoni, togidega ta ꞌuꞌenoꞌeno. Geya sowasowahiu ma tuta ꞌiꞌiuna tuwa ꞌoina ꞌuꞌoyatola, ꞌawa?”

Ma wete ꞌihegwaediya mabwaiyadi, ꞌigwae, “Cilobwainegomiya ma waꞌoꞌoyatola ma waꞌahwaꞌahwanoi, ma ꞌoinega geyaꞌabwa Seitani ꞌitohotoho hedadegomi. Moisa yaluyaluwami nuwanuwana, ma hesi wahimi siꞌelodabalala.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌilaga hila ma ꞌina ꞌahwanoiina ꞌilohileya.
Ma wete Yesu ꞌihila ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya, ꞌilobediya wete siꞌenosinediya, weyahina mata ꞌenoꞌeno ꞌiꞌewa pwaidiya. Ma ꞌilohanohanodiya, ta sitoholowa maꞌidi debamwadina, ma geya wete ꞌidi gwaemo.

Ta Yesu wete ꞌilaga ma ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi, ma ꞌina hilama hetoina ꞌoina ꞌilobediya siꞌenosinediya, ta ꞌihegwaediya, “Togidega, ꞌabwa waꞌenoꞌeno ma waꞌaiꞌaiyawasi? Ta ꞌigu tuta bewa ꞌilatu pwaima ma taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌiꞌiunamo sitebaegau togala ꞌoidiya.
Watoholo ma tatau, weyahina ꞌagu totebaina bewa ꞌinaonaoma.”
Yesu ꞌana ꞌabiyahina

Yesu ꞌabwa ꞌigwaegwae ma Yudasa ꞌihapwesama, tauna Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega. Beno weyahina topwaoliyao madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ta babadao sihewasaedima ꞌidi toꞌalehao Yudasa mahetediu ma ꞌabehega Yesu siꞌabiyahi, ma bodaedi ꞌidi ꞌebe ꞌalehao ta wepasi wete siꞌewediya.
Ma Yudasa ꞌilaꞌilalaina ꞌiꞌebwaya pwaiya ꞌoidiya, ꞌihepwaileya, ꞌigwae, “Ceguma taiya yaꞌatusapwali, beno tauna Yesu, ma waꞌabiyahi ma walomatayahi ma watauye.”
Coinega ꞌidumwaluwa Yesu ꞌoina ma ꞌihelauweya ma ꞌiꞌatusapwaliya.
Eeta bodaedi silatuma ma Yesuina siꞌabiyahiya.
Ma Yesu ꞌana bodao ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega ꞌitotoholo deina, ma ꞌina ꞌelepa ꞌilisiloloya, ma totaꞌona madouna ꞌina topaihowa tenana ꞌiꞌupwa yahuleya.
Ma Yesu boda ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Nuwana taugu toyagaha ta ꞌoinega maꞌimi ꞌebeꞌaleha ma maꞌimi wepasi wanaoma sabi ꞌabiyahigau.

Ta toꞌaha lamuna ꞌoinega geya waꞌabiyahigau sabwelowedi gamwagamwanimiya yamiyamiya Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ma yaheheꞌita tomota ꞌoidiya? Ma tuwa hesi ginaula bewa silatuma ma ꞌane palopitao ꞌidi gwae nugeta Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌalona sihapwesa bwaibwaina.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao mabwaiyadi sidena sineya.
Ma ꞌaigeda hewali maꞌana ꞌaleꞌo ꞌaigeda tuwa Yesu ꞌimuliyeya, ma toloꞌalehao nuwanuwadi siꞌabiyahi,
ta siꞌabisapuliya ta ꞌana ꞌaleꞌomo siꞌeweya, ma bugebugewanamo ꞌidena.
Yesu sitoeya toloinao ꞌoidiya
Ma Yesu sitoeyama ma siluhuweya topwaoli madouna ꞌina hada, weyahina hadaina ꞌoina topwaoli madoudi ta babadao ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao siꞌetoꞌautama.
Ma Pita bwagebwagega Yesu ꞌimulimuliye ma ꞌinaoma Topwaoli madouna ꞌina ꞌasa, ma Pitaina toꞌitayahinao baꞌidanao simiyatoiya ta ꞌaiwe ꞌoina simwaimwailu.
Eeta topwaoli madoudi ta babadaedi nuwanuwadi Yesu ꞌana toheꞌewao silobadi ma ꞌidi heꞌewaina ꞌoinega Yesu siloheꞌamasi, ma hesi geya ꞌeta wete siloba.
Weyahina toheꞌewao baibaiwadi sihehepwailamo, ma hesi ꞌidi hepwailaedi geya sihemahemahetena. Taudi mabwaiyadi toꞌabo tuwa.
Ma tupwadi ꞌoidiyega sitoholowa ma Yesu siheꞌewa ꞌaboꞌaboweya, sigwae,
“Yesu ꞌina gwae ꞌaigeda ꞌahesagoheya ꞌigwae, ‘Hada Heꞌasisi bewa tomota siꞌabiya, ꞌabwa yaligehi yahule, ma sabwelo ꞌetoi ꞌoidiya yaꞌabihila, ma geya tomota nimadiyega,’”
ma hesi ꞌidi heꞌewa ginaula bewa weyahina geya sihemahemahetena.
Coinega topwaoli madouna ꞌitoholowa gamwagamwanidiya, ma Yesu ꞌihesilaleya, ꞌigwae, “Geya ꞌuda hemaiseya, ꞌawa? Loheloheya ꞌidi heꞌewa ꞌoiuwa ꞌuhesagoheya?”
Ma Yesu tuwa ꞌihehenono ta geya wete ꞌida gwaeya. Eeta topwaoli madouna Yesu ꞌihesilala hileya, ꞌigwae, “Togidega, ꞌowa Yehoba natuna Toꞌabihetenaina, ꞌawa?”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Cehe! Taugu! Ma wete ꞌabwa taugu Loheyaiguina waꞌitegau Tohewaiwai moisa ꞌina ꞌebeulega yamiyamiya, ma wete galewa yaloha debadiyega yanaoma.”

Coinega topwaoli madounaina ꞌigamwasowala moisa, ꞌoinega ꞌiboinamo ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo ꞌiꞌigaliya, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Cina gwae galana wahesagoheya? Moisa, loheya bewa Yehoba ꞌisinaliya. Tuwa! Geyaꞌabwa wete ꞌana toheꞌewao sigwaegwaene ꞌina puiyao weyahidi. Togidega ꞌimi nuwatuhu Yesu weyahina?” Ma ꞌoinega mabwaiyadi sigwaeya, “Cilobwaineya tuwa ma ꞌiꞌamasa!”

Nage ꞌoina tupwadi tomota Yesu siꞌesoheya, ma matana ꞌaleꞌowega siwaduya, ma sihunu dadaneya maꞌidi ꞌehetete, sigwaeya, “Cuhegwaemai taiya ꞌihunugowa?” Ma toꞌita yahinedi Yesu siꞌabiyahiya, sisapiya ta sitauyeya.
Ta Pita ꞌabwa ꞌatamana ꞌimiyamiya, ma topwaoli madouna ꞌina topaihowa gumalaulauna ꞌaigeda ꞌilatuma,
ta Pita ꞌiꞌiteya ꞌimwaimwailu. Coinega wahineina Pita ꞌiꞌeꞌebubuya, ta ꞌigwaeya, “Yesu gwama Nasaleta ꞌowa mwalo baꞌidau wamiyamiya, ꞌawa?”
Ma Pita ꞌiuhala, ꞌigwaeya, “Ginaulaina ꞌugwaegwaene geya yasanapu toho.” Coinega Pita ꞌilatuwa mulimuliya.
Ma gumalaulauina Pita ꞌihenima susuweya tomiyaedi ꞌoidiya, ꞌigwaeya, “Loheya nage Yesu ꞌina boda ꞌaigeda.”
Ma Pita ꞌihesagoheya ma ꞌiuhala hila, ꞌigwae, “Taugu geya.” Tuta ꞌiꞌiuna mulina toꞌebubunaowedi Pita sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Moisa tuwa, ꞌuꞌabowa. Cowa Yesu ꞌina boda, weyahina ꞌowa gwama Galili.”
Coinega Pita ꞌiuhala moisa, ma gwae galana ꞌoinega ꞌibwauhaneya, ꞌigwae, “Yesu tauna wagwaegwaene, taugu geya yasanapu toho. Tamada!”

Ta tutaina ꞌoina ꞌamꞌam ꞌidouwa maluwa, ma nage ꞌoina Pita ꞌinuwatuhuya Yesu ꞌina gwaeina ꞌabehega “Muliyega ꞌabwa ꞌamꞌam ꞌidou maluwa, beno ꞌowa ꞌuuhalegau matoi.” Ma Pita ꞌina ꞌaboina galana ꞌinuwatuhuya, ma ꞌidouwa.
